anti_goals: Не менять camera parameters, JPEG encoder, IndexedDB или поиск.

stop_conditions: Stop on a newly required public/shared contract, owner change, production action or higher tier; route through owning workflow.

constraints: Planning Revision 4; direct accepted AC only; no new server cooldown, storage table, migration, device fingerprint, package dependency or production task.
touched_files is advisory; existing historical task identities/status/evidence remain unchanged.
Primary implementation is the public browser in client/; no server or public API change.
invariants: The browser may only call the accepted public API; server search/profile and all-date selection authority remain with their existing owners.
Tests and RED/GREEN prove only this task-owned AC; dependent historical evidence is prerequisite, not adopted proof.
verification_targets: FT-013-AC-010: Playwright capture с реальным camera fixture на representative desktop/mobile viewport: screenshot/DOM timing от нажатия «Жмак меня», белая область вне круга, видимый круг, 50–100 ms и сохранённый capture.
